descriptions.overview: The workspace at a glance: turns, people, failures and tokens, against the period before.
descriptions.activity: Who works with which socios, how often, and through which channels.
descriptions.value: Which work gets finished, which is left, and what people come back for.
descriptions.themes: What people come to socios for: intents and recurring topics, and which get left unfinished.
descriptions.knowledge: Spaces and pages, datasets and storage: what is written, searched and used, what goes stale, and how full the limits are.
descriptions.reliability: What fails and why: turns, tools, retries and fallbacks.
descriptions.capabilities: What socios can do, what they are asked for and can’t, and what gets used.
descriptions.health: Models, queues, schedules, backups, and how fresh these numbers are.
descriptions.cost: What turns cost, by model, socio, person and backend; self-hosted backends’ cost pools; and the prices behind them.
descriptions.access-log: Each time an admin opened a person’s activity, a chat or a turn’s trace. Every admin sees every entry.
descriptions.socio-access: Which socios may use which apps for whom, right now, and ending that access.
descriptions.settings: The reporting time zone the dashboard cuts days in, how sessions are cut, retention, the price sync, and what the model may label.
